scope: Supplemental clarification only. Published bundle, manifest and receipts remain immutable. No source edits or check reruns. No original stream text is included.
terminology: These files are redacted transport copies of raw command receipts. Embedded stdoutSha256/stderrSha256 continue to identify the original pre-transport raw streams; they do not automatically identify the decoded transported strings.

redactionRule.implementation: Reviewed scripts/orchestration/review-bundle.mjs redactReceipt function at tested source head.
redactionRule.algorithm: Decode original receipt bytes as UTF-8; replace literal canonical source-root, requested source-root and exporting-home substrings, longest needle first, throughout the whole receipt text; encode UTF-8. No parsing, truncation or other text changes.

sourceRootBoundary.duplicateNeedle: Canonical/requested strings are identical here; the second pass makes no additional replacements.

redactionRule.embeddedStrings: The whole-text rule also redacts matching path substrings inside JSON-encoded stdout/stderr values.
redactionRule.localReceiptBoundary: Earlier e0a76db4 receipts use a different checkout root; they are unchanged by this exporter invocation.

hashMethod: SHA-256 of exact original/transported receipt bytes; stream hashes are SHA-256 of each decoded JSON stdout/stderr string encoded as UTF-8.
